parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by a nuclear fission reaction.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: A student suggests that one possible nuclear reaction is $$^{56}_{26}\text{Fe} + ^{1}_{0}\text{n} \rightarrow ^{20}_{9}\text{F} + ^{37}_{17}\text{Cl}$$ The binding energy per nucleon of a nucleus varies with the nucleon number. Use this variation to explain why the reaction would not result in an overall release of energy.
